name: Rethinking Discovery Research with AI: The promise of transdisciplinarity and the danger of reductionism

raw_payload.title: Rethinking Discovery Research with AI: The promise of transdisciplinarity and the danger of reductionism
raw_payload.summary: In theory, transdisciplinary research focuses on solving real-world problems without being constrained by disciplinary boundaries and methodologies. In practice, doing so is challenging, as recognized by the phrase "The world has problems; universities have departments." As a powerful integrative tool, AI may help overcome traditional reductionist approaches and enable genuine transdisciplinarity. In this essay, we discuss how this could happen and why, within the current system of incentives, it is not happening.
